text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks. This means thinking carefully about what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a risk actually occurs. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and make better decisions.
